description: A patient can be hooked up to two machines to have medicine delivered, machine 1 and machine 2. Machine 1 delivers 0.5 units of medicine to the heart per minute and 0.8 units of medicine per minute to the brain. Machine 2 delivers 0.3 units of medicine per minute to the heart and 1 unit of medicine per minute to the brain. In addition however, machine 1 creates 0.3 units of waste per minute while machine 2 creates 0.5 units of waste per minute. If at most 8 units of medicine can be received by the heart and at least 4 units of medicine should be received by the brain, how many minutes should each machine be used to minimize the total amount of waste produced?

Machine1HeartDeliveryRate.definition: Units of medicine delivered to the heart per minute by machine 1

Machine1BrainDeliveryRate.definition: Units of medicine delivered to the brain per minute by machine 1

Machine1WasteRate.definition: Units of waste produced per minute by machine 1

Machine2HeartDeliveryRate.definition: Units of medicine delivered to the heart per minute by machine 2

Machine2BrainDeliveryRate.definition: Units of medicine delivered to the brain per minute by machine 2

Machine2WasteRate.definition: Units of waste produced per minute by machine 2

HeartMedicineMax.definition: Maximum units of medicine that can be received by the heart

BrainMedicineMin.definition: Minimum units of medicine that should be received by the brain

objective.description: "Minimize the total amount of waste produced by the two machines"
